input.summary: Add express conformity-to-Specifications warranty (90 days) with repair/re-perform/refund remedy
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 5 contains no warranty that the Services and Works will conform to the Specifications, and no remedy if they do not, so we have added a 90-day conformity warranty with re-performance, repair or refund. This matches our standard position that the Contractor stands behind its work for a defined period.

ops.text: (e) Contractor represents and warrants to Company that (i) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards, and (ii) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each of the Works and any deliverables will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and documentation. Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Contractor's option, re-performance, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Services or Works, or a refund of the fees paid for such non-conforming Services or Works.
